newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, The Dow Jones industrial average rose 4.42 points to close at 6,931.62 following rises in several blue-chips, but was down 57.34 points on the week
* On Friday, the Jakarta Composite Index fell 2.17 points, 0.31 percent, to close at 696.50 points after touching a high of 700.23. The index was off 7.98 points, or 1.13 percent, on the week.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,391.20/2.20 in early trading against the opening of 2,390.00/1.00.
* On Monday, the Jakarta stock exchange was scheduled to launch the LQ45 index, which will track 45 of the most liquid shares listed on the bourse. It will also be pegged to market capitalisation.
* Bank Bira on being awarded the best domestic investment bank in Asia Pacific by Hong Kong's Finance Asia magazine.
* Car maker Astra International on a media report last Friday the company and its Japanese principal were discussing Indonesia's national car policy and local content in autombiles produced by Astra.
* Glue maker Kurnia Kapuas on its plan of a stock split and to expand its activities into other sectors.
* Spring producer PT Indospring on market talk that a founder shareholder was planning to increase its stake in the company.
* Indonesian salt producer PT Fiskaragung Perkasa on its announcement that the firm had revised up its 1997 net profit forecast to 144 billion rupiah from 104.1 billion rupiah.
